english.meaning: a canopy or dome of sky
english.note: Seen in the name 天幕沙灘. This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Thinking of going again—hot springs or a canopy beach?
exampleSentences.traditional: 諗住去多次，去乜嘢浸溫泉吖嗎。天幕沙灘呀？
